cues: Water keeps leaving, and the protoplast shrinks away from the wall.
And notice what fills the gap: the outside sugar solution, because the cell wall is freely permeable.
text: Water keeps leaving, and the protoplast shrinks away from the wall. The cell is plasmolysed. And notice what fills the gap: the outside sugar solution, because the cell wall is freely permeable. Only the membranes are selective.
